format: 3-line TLE (name line + line 1 + line 2), verbatim CelesTrak output
note: All four files are drawn from the SAME capture instant, so element-set epochs are mutually consistent and a screening run anchored to capturedAtUtc is physically valid. Screening far from this epoch degrades: SGP4 accuracy falls off over weeks, not years. Refresh with scripts/fetch-snapshot.sh to screen against today.

groups.note: Reconstructed from the capture's active-satellite set by the membership CelesTrak's `stations` group carried in Nov 2024: ISS and CSS modules plus visiting crew and cargo vehicles.

ISRO-operated spacecraft in LEO, reconstructed from the same capture by catalogue name (Cartosat, Resourcesat, Oceansat, RISAT, Astrosat, SARAL and the rest). Restricted to LEO: a GEO communications satellite cannot conjunct with these debris clouds, so including one would pad the count without adding a screenable object.
Tracked fragments of Cosmos 1408, destroyed by a Russian direct-ascent ASAT test on 2021-11-15. This cloud is why the ISS crew sheltered in their return vehicles.
Fragments of Iridium 33, destroyed in the 2009-02-10 collision with Cosmos 2251 — the first accidental hypervelocity collision between two intact satellites.
The other half of the 2009 Iridium 33 / Cosmos 2251 collision.
